bug_semantics: CVE-2026-74892 / GHSA-qg6r-j76g-wv2q (vendor GHSA-p926-6hjp-w9jw) claim CWE-798: server/telemetry-server/app/config.py defaults secret_key to CHANGE_THIS_IN_PRODUCTION and uses it for API-key hashing, so a known default lets an attacker predict or forge hashes. The literal default exists, but settings.secret_key is never consumed by auth; KeyService.hash_api_key is unsalted SHA-256 of the random API key only.
